$comment: Static fixture. `pop_nonce` `AQIDBAUGBwgJCgsMDQ4P` is the 15-byte truncation of the outstanding challenge nonce. The proof is minted over the 192-byte proof_input with that nonce; both KAT scripts re-verify it. The sender is in `trust_store` so the only defect is the nonce length. Extension-gated: the pinned-admission profile of RFC-AITP-0002 §3.4 is OPTIONAL, so this fixture is `status: extension` under `feature: aitp-pinned-admission`. The default runner MUST SKIP it. A runner testing an implementation that claims "AITP v0.2 pinned-admission" conformance executes it, and that implementation MUST pass it (RFC-AITP-0001 §10 item 9).
description: A presented `pop_nonce` that does not decode to exactly 16 bytes MUST be rejected with IDENTITY_FAILED before any signature verification (RFC-AITP-0002 §3.4, nonce rules and check-order step 5). The verifier issued a 16-byte nonce; the presenter returns its first 15 bytes. The proof is a real Ed25519 signature over the 192-byte tuple built with that 15-byte nonce, so a verifier that skips the length check and verifies the proof against the presented nonce finds the signature valid.

expected.rationale: RFC-AITP-0002 §3.4: `pop_nonce` MUST decode to exactly 16 bytes, and any other length is rejected with IDENTITY_FAILED before any signature verification. The 15-byte nonce also matches no issued nonce, but the length check comes first (step 5), so neither the envelope signature nor the proof is evaluated.
